description: This file defines the ThemeUtils singleton object which provides styling helpers for applying Ocean Professional visual styles to Android Views, including creating background drawables with focus and selection states, applying focus outlines, and retrieving color resources.

methods.name: makeCardBackground
methods.description: Creates a StateListDrawable with focused and normal states for a card background, using specified corner radius.

methods.name: applyFocusOutline
methods.description: Adds focus visualization behavior to a View, changing elevation and scale when focused.

methods.name: colorTextPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves the primary text color from resources.
